# Beat

Beat maker: instrumental hip hop, trap, lo-fi, drill, afrobeats and house beats generated at the tempo and mood you choose.

## What it does
Pick the genre, tempo and mood, and the instruments. Claude tells you the price and creates the beat.

**How the files are made:** each beat is generated by an audio model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Instrumentals only.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install beat@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Beat talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/beat/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each beat uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The beat plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_beat_models` | Models for beats with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_beat_cost` | Exact price of one beat before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_beat` | Starts one beat in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_beat` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A dark trap beat at 140 BPM with heavy 808s"
- "A chill lo-fi beat at 80 BPM with piano"
- "An afrobeats instrumental, uplifting, 105 BPM"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the beat (the genre, the tempo, the mood and the instruments) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
